avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces ondansetron plasma concentrations and antiemetic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout period before starting ondansetron

avoid_supplements.name: Serotonin-enhancing supplements (5-HTP, L-tryptophan)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive serotonergic effects may increase risk of serotonin syndrome, though ondansetron risk is lower than other agents
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor for agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, or muscle rigidity; use with caution

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase ondansetron levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (headache, constipation); limit concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly elevate ondansetron concentrations
caution_supplements.action: No dose adjustment typically needed; monitor for tolerability

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase ondansetron bioavailability and systemic exposure
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and related citrus (pomelo, Seville orange); advise patient to choose alternative beverages

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay ondansetron absorption and slightly reduce peak concentrations, but overall exposure unchanged
caution_foods.action: Take ondansetron with or without food; if GI upset occurs, administer with light meals

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; may worsen sedation or dizziness
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit alcohol consumption during treatment

monitoring_notes: Ondansetron has a relatively low interaction potential due to its hepatic metabolism and limited enzyme induction/inhibition properties. Monitor for constipation (common side effect) and assess antiemetic efficacy, particularly if CYP3A4 inducers are co-administered.
